name: Tōgō (Aichi, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tōgō town emblem in green: a stylised letter S-shaped device with a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Tōgō, a town in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 13 May 1970.

features.role: Tōgō town emblem — a stylised letter S-shaped device with a disc
